learning_outcomes.text: Familiarize students with the physical character of processes and phenomena in nature and the methods for their investigation.
Familiarize students with the most general properties of matter and the material objects.
Create skills for experimental investigation of physical phenomena and solving physical problems.

syllabus_topics: Kinematics and Dynamics of material point and rigid body
teaching_methods: Demonstrations of physics phenomena and processes

assessment_methods.method: Regular testing of knowledge from lecture material and laboratory classes

assessment_rules: The final mark is formed after an exam in the form of a test. Knowledge of lecture material and laboratory classes is tested regularly.
degree: Computer Aided Design in Mechanical and Instrument Engineering (Bachelor)
academic_year: Paquete ECTS de la FMME (datos 2008/09-posteriores; ver notas)
